title: Dispatch one archive-only Project intent

requirements.invariant: One archive intent binds exact AccountID and stable ProjectID. Display text, Client identity, route, provider path, copied lifecycle state, readiness/as-of/query evidence or cached metadata cannot define Project identity.

Archive is distinct from rename, Client reassignment and physical deletion. This archive-only application boundary carries no lifecycle Boolean and cannot restore, unarchive, delete, rename, edit, reassign, or mutate children/accounting; it makes no physical history-preservation claim.

ProjectArchiveIntent is transient, Equatable and Sendable but non-Codable, and contains exactly AccountID, ProjectID and ExpectedProjectRevision. It defines no validation helper, fingerprint, codec, operation metadata, restart durability, confirmation, cancellation, dismissal or other UI policy.

ProjectArchiveUseCase receives the intent plus caller OperationID, PrincipalID, operation contract version and finite capture time; constructs the existing ProjectArchiveDraft and ArchiveProjectCommand; invokes ProjectArchiving exactly once only after construction; validates the receipt; returns its exact local state; preserves CancellationError and normalized ProjectArchiveFailure; and maps every other port error to ProjectArchiveFailure.localAcceptanceFailed.

This target-only slice implements archive-intent dispatch only. Source surface SWIFT-D73C92887393 remains characterized and blocked by O-024 because ProjectDetailView also owns tabs, export, quick-note, edit, restore/unarchive, delete, lifecycle display, confirmation/dismissal and composition responsibilities that do not advance here. MCPTOOL-921DA05B3330 remains target_mapped across separate ArchiveProjectCommand and RestoreProjectCommand responsibilities, but this slice advances only archive-true dispatch; restore implementation, MCP wiring, authorization and result presentation remain unimplemented.

Exactly two target-only leaves may change. ProjectCoreDetailsUpdate is only a future composition dependency: this slice consumes no Project read/readiness update and decides no waiting/partial/stale/failure-cache, active/already-archived eligibility or no-op behavior. SwiftUI, physical persistence/history proof, optimistic projection, authorization, schema/RLS/Sync, provider, app/MCP, migration, hosted resources, production, release and cutover do not advance.

The verified Project archive operation remains sole owner of ExpectedProjectRevision, the exact same-Project revision precondition, ProjectArchiveDraft, ArchiveProjectCommand, subject, fingerprint, receipt validation and ProjectArchiveFailure semantics. This use case composes those contracts without redefining or extending them.

items: ProjectArchiveIntent is a non-Codable transient value containing exact Account/Project/expected-revision identity and no lifecycle flag, UI policy, read evidence or operation metadata.

ProjectArchiveUseCase adds caller operation metadata, constructs the existing verified draft/command, invokes one ProjectArchiving call after construction, validates the receipt and returns its exact local state.
Structured-concurrency cancellation and normalized ProjectArchiveFailure values remain distinct; every unexpected port error becomes localAcceptanceFailed.
The existing Project archive operation remains the sole owner of command, subject, precondition, fingerprint, receipt-validation and stable-failure semantics.

items: Implementation may change only the two provider-free target leaves; ProjectDetailView, the Firebase application and both app projects remain unchanged.
The deterministic in-memory port cannot visibly or authoritatively archive, restore, unarchive or delete a Project, preserve history in storage, deploy, migrate, release or cut over behavior.
O-024/O-025 and A-003/A-004/A-007/A-015/A-016 remain open or outside; D-026/D-027 contribute only target-isolation requirements.

verification.expected: ProjectArchiveIntent exposes exactly AccountID, ProjectID and ExpectedProjectRevision; accepts revision zero and UInt64.max; is non-Codable; and exposes no Client, lifecycle Boolean, read/readiness/as-of/query/cache, child, accounting, operation, provider or UI field.

A reciprocal matrix independently varies exact Account, Project, expected revision, Operation, actor, contract and time; each value reaches the existing draft/command and derived subject/precondition/fingerprint exactly, with one port call and no added policy or field.

Every valid construction invokes ProjectArchiving exactly once; non-finite capturedAt fails before dispatch with zero calls. The recorded command has one ArchiveProject payload and same-Project expected-revision precondition and no restore/delete/child/accounting operation; no physical effect is claimed.

Each matching OperationReceipt local state is returned exactly. Receipt mismatch is rejected; CancellationError is preserved; a normalized ProjectArchiveFailure distinct from the fallback is preserved; and a raw unexpected port error becomes ProjectArchiveFailure.localAcceptanceFailed, with exact zero/one call counts.

Stable diagnostics reveal no raw error, Account/Project/Operation/Principal value, credential, provider path or payload. Separate reflected/recorded/encoded shape checks prove only authorized existing command fields and no UI/readiness/lifecycle toggle/Client/child/accounting/restore/unarchive/delete/provider field, without claiming intent or use-case encoding.

The exact implementation commit passes traceability, source/provider isolation, generated contracts, focused and complete tests, warnings-as-errors, repeatable project generation, both staging builds and clean artifacts while implementation changes only the two target leaves and ProjectDetailView/Firebase files remain untouched and unadvanced.

notes: Verified at exact implementation commit 232acf922b6c1ab1016017c3ebc3b926b164466c after immutable Actions run 33758116150 passed traceability in 9 seconds and the isolated target job in 3 minutes 8 seconds. ProjectDetailView, restore implementation, MCP integration, physical durability/history proof, provider and production behavior remain excluded.
